President Trump is praising NVIDIA's decision to reinstate Jensen Wong as the company's CEO.
Trump has been friendly with Wong through much of his second term and continued to praise him
even after news that Wong was linked to a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.
Here's NPR's Danielle Kurtzleben.
In a social media post, Trump wrote that Wong should lead the company, quote, "in order to ensure the success and prosperity of not only the company but the American economy."
He added that the U.S. government, quote, "has no reason to believe that Jensen's return to NVIDIA poses any risk to national security."
In announcing the reinstatement, NVIDIA said that they had, quote, "received input from senior levels of the United States government, helping them conclude that Wong was not a security risk."
Secretary of State Marco Rubio drafted a memo earlier this year warning that Wong was in a relationship with a woman whom U.S. intelligence services believed to have ties to a Chinese spy agency.
Danielle Kurtzleben, NPR News, The White House.
Gasoline prices in the U.S. continue to fall as millions of Americans begin traveling for the Thanksgiving holiday.
AAA says regular gas is now averaging about $3.64 a gallon.
It's a drop of roughly 65 cents over the last month amid fewer disruptions to oil tankers in the Middle East.
The National Weather Service's holiday travelers could see stormy weather this week, though.
Here's NPR's Andrea Shue.
On the West Coast, a confluence of two things could bring flooding, rain fueled by wide bands of moisture and king tides expected to be among the highest tides this year.
Western Oklahoma, Texas, the Great Lakes and New England could see snow, the Southeast and the East Coast heavy wind and rain.
Matthew Capucci, senior meteorologist with MyRadar, says altogether it's shaping up to be quite the week.
It's going to start eventful on one coast and kind of end eventful on the other coast, unfortunately.
Airport delays are likely.
AAA expects some 81 million Americans to travel this Thanksgiving.
Nearly six million are expected to fly.
Andrea Shue, NPR News.
Poland wants to ramp up surveillance capabilities and deploy more F-35s to intercept incoming missiles and drones after Russia fired three cruise missiles into Polish territory.
It called an emergency session of NATO members today.
Terry Schultz reports on Russia's strike, the latest carried out beyond the borders of its more than four year old offensive in Ukraine.
The detection system did work.
The anti-missile systems and NATO flights were activated, but Polish authorities say the weather was too bad to have the necessary precision to shoot down the incoming missiles.
Polish authorities said there was no injuries or damage on the ground.
Now, a little over a year ago, NATO set up what's called Eastern Sentry to put more air defense in place after a huge drone swarm from Russia crossed into Poland.
But now I'm sure experts will be looking for gaps and backups.
That's Terry Schultz reporting from Brussels.
This is NPR News.
Two of the biggest names in cybersecurity are merging.
CrowdStrike says it's buying Zscaler in an all stock deal worth nearly $44 billion.
CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz announced a deal today following a series of tech outages and hacks across public and private sectors in recent weeks from the FAA to banks to Microsoft Outlook.
Kurtz writes, "Security used to be about keeping the adversary out adding today. Safety is required to let AI in."
Mushrooms are among the latest wellness supplement trends peddled online.
Reporter Ari Daniel says there is some promising new research.
Medicinal mushrooms are a good source of vitamin D2 and antioxidants.
Their cell walls improve gut health, and there are studies suggesting that a purified extract from the turkey tail mushroom slightly improved the survival rate in cancer patients who'd undergone surgical removal of a gastric tumor and chemotherapy.
But there's still a lot we don't know, says Santoshi Narayanan of the UTMD Anderson Cancer Center.
We need to do more research and understand how we can use it, like which patients benefit from which type of mushroom.
In addition, some dietitians recommend a few nutrition basics, like eating more fiber or protein, or eating out less often, before taking supplements.
For NPR News, I'm Ari Daniel.
As people head to markets to gather up everything for Thanksgiving dinner, the American Farm Bureau warns be ready to pay more.
It's projecting a 6 percent increase in costs to feed 10 guests.
